label: Cloud / Internet
description: Simulated Internet / WAN service edge. A multi-port upstream: four RJ45 subscriber hand-offs from 1G to 10G, 10G/25G/100G optical hand-offs, plus GPON, XGS-PON, DOCSIS 3.1 and VDSL2 line ports, so multihoming and fibre/coax/DSL access can be modelled against the same object.
notes: Synthetic object: the network has no vendor datasheet, so these ports are not a hardware census. They exist because a one-port cloud made every lab terminate on copper and made a second WAN, a PON ONT, a cable modem or a DSL router impossible to place upstream (issue #30). Each port's connector and rate are the ones the engine already models for that service family: rj45 for ethernet, sfp+/sfp28/qsfp28 for optical hand-offs, sc-apc for GPON/XGS-PON, f for DOCSIS 3.1 and rj11 for VDSL2 35b. eth0 is retained unchanged (10G RJ45) because every shipped example and any saved lab cables the cloud to eth0; the new ports sit alongside it rather than replacing it.
